subject.title: feat: add lease-bound metadata to session spawns

question: Should lease-bound external-orchestrator session metadata become a supported generic OpenClaw Gateway capability, or should the Agentic OS-specific contract live in its owner integration through an existing or newly designed extension seam?
rationale: This PR creates a durable public RPC and persisted-data contract. The correct long-term owner and compatibility promise cannot be determined mechanically from the patch.

options.title: Design a generic core seam
options.body: Sponsor a narrow, owner-neutral Gateway or plugin API and require this feature to move its Agentic OS-specific policy and metadata onto that seam.

options.title: Keep it integration-owned
options.body: Move the contract to the Agentic OS integration or plugin and request only the minimal missing generic extension API from core.

options.title: Accept the core contract
options.body: Explicitly approve the named core RPC and persistence contract, including its long-term compatibility and upgrade obligations.

recommendation.title: Design a generic core seam
recommendation.body: Sponsor a narrow, owner-neutral Gateway or plugin API and require this feature to move its Agentic OS-specific policy and metadata onto that seam.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only evidence-backed design contact for the proposed contract and paired downstream integration; a core Gateway/state owner should co-sponsor any acceptance decision.
